scope:
Original EM1 sequence/random playlist kernels and state mutations.

Executes8032ce90/8032d420, native bitsets/history updates and C rand80017940.
Playlist storage and already-allocated history/bitsets are supplied; count and
weight access execute the original playlist methods. Only memset is supplied.
No bank admission, global/per-object registry, missing-child retry, continuous
voice scheduling, allocation failure or audio mixing is executed.
